limitations: Synthetic fixed-load switched sines; no measured contact physics
64 continuous probes do not establish full-window atlas 1e-4 accuracy
Finite non-ideal kernel; no sufficient-bandwidth or pure-alias claim
Offline acausal output; no Engine/streaming/callback/causal-latency claim
Mathematical ideal output bound is not a certified floating-point headroom gate

observations.elapsed_measurement: Monotonic earliest script initialization through report preparation and preceding encoding passes; excludes Python startup, final metadata encoding and atomic publication; retain an external full-process timer
observations.fir_products_meaning: Conservative full-support product bound; zero-routing and clipped-tail shortcuts are not subtracted; actual multiplication instructions are not instrumented
observations.resident_scope: Process-lifetime peak; includes setup, candidate, oracle and report construction
